pages.text: A stabilizer keeps the chunk entropy below the critical level (the charged cap, 80 %). Inducers waste the extra. This makes the best output (charged) possible at a base.$(br2)Tier I: its own chunk. Tier II: 3x3 chunks. Tier III: 5x5 chunks.
Tier II needs tier I in the centre.
Tier III needs tier II in the centre.
A redstone signal turns the crystal off. Then the chunk can go critical on purpose. Mine it to get it back with its tier.$(br2)In the Entropy biome it does nothing.
